exam.start.back.label: Back link
exam.start.back.hint: The card at the top of every exam, before it starts

exam.start.questions.label: Questions label
exam.start.questions.hint: The card at the top of every exam, before it starts. Under the number of questions

exam.start.duration.label: Duration label
exam.start.duration.hint: The card at the top of every exam, before it starts. Under the time allowed

exam.start.passMark.label: Pass mark label
exam.start.passMark.hint: The card at the top of every exam, before it starts. Under the pass mark

exam.start.minutes.label: Minutes
exam.start.minutes.hint: How a time allowed is written, on the card and in the list of other papers. {n} is the number of minutes

exam.start.shuffle.label: Shuffle switch
exam.start.shuffle.hint: The card at the top of every exam. Only offered on a paper whose questions do not build on one another

exam.start.shuffleHint.value: Off, so everyone sitting this paper gets the questions in the same order and question 7 is question 7 for the whole room. Turn it on for a re-sit, or to practise without learning the order.
exam.start.shuffleHint.label: Shuffle explanation

exam.start.examMode.label: Exam mode button
exam.start.examMode.hint: The card at the top of every exam. Starts the timed paper

exam.start.practiceMode.label: Practice mode button
exam.start.practiceMode.hint: The card at the top of every exam. Starts the untimed paper, and is shown in the bar at the top while practising

exam.start.modesHint.value: Exam mode is timed with answers at the end. Practice mode is untimed and reveals answers as you go.
exam.start.modesHint.label: Modes explanation

exam.others.one.value: The other paper in this set
exam.others.one.label: Heading, one other paper
exam.others.one.hint: Above the link to the other paper for the same qualification, under the start card and under the score

exam.others.many.label: Heading, several other papers
exam.others.many.hint: Above the links to the other papers for the same qualification, under the start card and under the score

exam.others.questions.label: Number of questions
exam.others.questions.hint: Beside each of the other papers. {n} is the number

exam.play.loading.label: Loading
exam.play.loading.hint: While a paper is being sat. Shown for a moment while the questions arrive

exam.play.question.label: Question
exam.play.question.hint: While a paper is being sat. Before the question number in the top bar, on the Question tab and in the progress panel

exam.play.answered.label: Answered count
exam.play.answered.hint: While a paper is being sat, in the top bar. {n} is how many

exam.play.flagged.label: Flagged count
exam.play.flagged.hint: While a paper is being sat, in the top bar. {n} is how many

exam.play.scenario.label: Scenario tab
exam.play.scenario.hint: While a paper is being sat. Only on a paper with a scenario

exam.play.matching.label: Matching label
exam.play.matching.hint: Above a matching question. {n} is how many rows it has

exam.play.options.label: Matching options heading
exam.play.options.hint: Above the options of a matching question

exam.play.selectN.label: Select how many
exam.play.selectN.hint: Under a question with more than one right answer. {n} is how many to choose

exam.play.confirm.label: Confirm button
exam.play.confirm.hint: In practice mode, on a question with more than one right answer

exam.nav.flagged.label: Next flagged button
exam.nav.flagged.hint: The buttons under each question. Only once something is flagged

exam.nav.unflag.label: Unflag button
exam.nav.unflag.hint: The buttons under each question. Replaces Flag on a flagged question

exam.nav.finish.label: Finish button
exam.nav.finish.hint: The buttons under each question. Ends the paper and marks it

exam.nav.progress.label: Progress heading
exam.nav.progress.hint: The panel of numbered squares beside the question

exam.nav.legendAnswered.label: Key: answered
exam.nav.legendAnswered.hint: The key under the progress panel

exam.nav.legendFlagged.label: Key: flagged
exam.nav.legendFlagged.hint: The key under the progress panel

exam.nav.legendCurrent.label: Key: current
exam.nav.legendCurrent.hint: The key under the progress panel

exam.results.passed.label: Passed
exam.results.passed.hint: The score, once a paper is finished

exam.results.notPassed.label: Not passed
exam.results.notPassed.hint: The score, once a paper is finished

exam.results.summary.label: Score line
exam.results.summary.hint: Under the score. {percent}, {passMark} and {unanswered} are filled in

exam.results.reference.label: Reference
exam.results.reference.hint: Under each marked answer that has one. {reference} is filled in

exam.meta.description.value: Free {subject} practice exam with answers and explanations.
exam.meta.description.label: Search description, when a paper has none
exam.meta.description.hint: What Google shows under a paper that has no description of its own. {subject} is the qualification, from the paper's title

exam.meta.notFound.label: Not found title
exam.meta.notFound.hint: The browser tab on an address with no published exam
